body:
Spec: .adlc/specs/install-experience.md (I3 section is binding). Blocked by I2: this ticket renders the universal install command I2 defines and MUST NOT publish a `curl | sh` string the installer does not yet serve.

=== CONTEXT ===
IntegrationDetailPage currently orders its sections hero -> surfaces -> phase routing -> rails -> install (LAST). The hero's right column renders NativeBundle, a decorative file tree. The /integrations index is a bare card grid with no install command, and the marketing homepage hero offers only a link ("Install for your agent") rather than a command. Time to first install is the metric; the CTA is buried on every surface.

The docs test suite asserts over component SOURCE ORDER (see apps/docs/test/codex-docs-current.test.mjs). It does not render React and no renderer is available. Verification must follow that convention.

=== TASK ===
1. In integration-detail.tsx, swap the hero's right column from <NativeBundle> to <IntegrationCard>, and relocate <NativeBundle> into the Native surfaces section. Keep the bottom install section intact with its OperatingCommands and ResourceNav.
2. Add apps/docs/lib/install-commands.mjs exporting a single UNIVERSAL_INSTALL constant. Every surface imports it; no page hand-types an install string. integration-facts.mjs remains the source of truth for the per-harness lines.
3. Add the universal command atop apps/docs/app/(home)/integrations/page.tsx, before the integration card grid.
4. Add the copy-able universal command to the homepage hero in apps/docs/app/(home)/page.tsx, before the "The problem" section.
5. Add apps/docs/test/install-cta.test.mjs asserting the source-order and single-source properties below.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC3.1: In integration-detail.tsx the <IntegrationCard usage index is greater than the hero MarketingSection opening index and less than the surfacesSection usage index. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/install-cta.test.mjs` hero-order case passes.
- AC3.2: <NativeBundle still appears, at a source index greater than <IntegrationCard. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/install-cta.test.mjs` bundle case passes.
- AC3.3: installSection, <OperatingCommands, and <ResourceNav all still appear, with <ResourceNav last. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/install-cta.test.mjs` tail case passes.
- AC3.4: UNIVERSAL_INSTALL is used in app/(home)/integrations/page.tsx before INTEGRATIONS.map(. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/install-cta.test.mjs` index case passes.
- AC3.5: UNIVERSAL_INSTALL is used in app/(home)/page.tsx before the "The problem" kicker. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/install-cta.test.mjs` homepage case passes.
- AC3.6: The UNIVERSAL_INSTALL literal appears in no file under apps/docs/app/ or apps/docs/components/ other than its defining module. VERIFY: `node --test apps/docs/test/install-cta.test.mjs` single-source case passes.
title: Lift the install CTA above the fold on the homepage, the integrations index, and every integration detail page
